# Introduction

#### Course: Learn C++ STL

## Introduction

In C++, the std::list class implements the functionality of a doubly linked list data structure.

![C++ List](data:image/png;base64,)

Each element of the linked list is known as a node and consists of 3 components:

- Prev - stores the address of the previous element ( NULL or nullptr for the first element)
- Next - stores the address of the next element (NULL or nullptr for the last element)
- Data - stores the actual data
